messages:
nina_cs: Heads-up  VerdantAI renewal next Wed. Request from account team: customer scorecard showing 90d uptime, P99 latency for /v1/generate and /v1/embed, regional daily availability, fallback rate, and a sample credit calculation if latency breaches SLO. Can Eng/SRE help pull and package?

omar_sre: We can. Which exact SLO definitions should we use for the calc? Verdant's contract lists: uptime >= 99.5% monthly, P99 latency <= 600ms for embeddings and <= 900ms for generation. Use last 90d window.

leah_eng: I'll export the per-route P99 and daily uptime from Grafana. Quick PromQL for P99 by region for generation:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le,region))
```I'll swap route for embeddings.

omar_sre: Great. I'll produce the credit worksheet. For partial latency degradations we weight minutes by region traffic share. I'll include a worked example showing how a 30-minute EU spike maps to credit % for the month.

tom_enablement: On the onboarding side, Verdant has 3 open items: dataset mapping review, webhook retry config, and a recorded ops runbook. Can I add an "Enablement Status" section to the scorecard with completion states and one-paragraph next steps? I can draft the copy and the meeting invite text.

nina_cs: Yes please. Also include a one-line "customer impact" blurb for execs and a separate technical appendix for Legal.

metrics-bot: Created ticket CS-5419 assigned to @leah_eng and @omar_sre. ETA field set to 2025-04-04.

leah_eng: Deliverables I'll attach to the bundle: 1) CSV: daily uptime % by region (90d) 2) CSV: P99 per-region per-route 3) CSV: fallback model counts + RPS 4) README (short) with queries and methodology. ETA 2025-04-03 EOD.

omar_sre: I'll add the credit-calc CSV + short worked example, include rounding rules and handling for blips < 1 minute. Also will annotate any anomalies (e.g., last-month eu-central spike on 2025-01-18).

tom_enablement: I'll draft the enablement block and proposed 30/60/90 actions. Will also add a link for the customer to book the follow-up ops session.

nina_cs: Perfect. Once bundles are in, I'll assemble the PDF scorecard, include the enablement block, and route to Legal for renewal language. If any of you spot data anomalies, flag here immediately. Thanks team :pray:

leah_eng: Noted. I'll surface any anomalies in the README and attach raw traces for any event >15m.

omar_sre: Adding: for credit calc we use weighted minutes by region traffic. Example will show math and final credit exposure as a percent of monthly invoice.

metrics-bot: CS-5419 state updated to "In progress".
